# SmartGift (Business 01) — AI-Native B2B Corporate Gift Operating System

> SmartGift (`TN001B01`, Business 01 in EtohGroup / Zuri-AI ecosystem) is an AI-native B2B manufacturer and distributor of premium corporate gift sets, executive drinkware, tech lifestyle accessories, and promotional merchandise.

## 1. Quick Reference & Core Invariants
- **FlowAccount Normalized SKU Pattern:** `^[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+\([A-Z0-9_-]+\)$` (e.g. `TMS06-4(P-16)`, `TMS06-3(P-06)`, `BW00-0(P-BAG)`).
- **Direct Single-Drop Freight:** Flat rate of 2,500 THB per batch is absorbed directly into Landed Cost ($2,500 / Qty$). Customer quotes display 0.00 THB for standard domestic delivery.
- **Customization Irreversibility:** Once raw hardware (tumbler, power bank) is laser-engraved or screen-printed with a client logo, stock locks to `CUSTOMER_DEDICATED`. It can never be returned to generic stock.
- **Append-Only Stock Ledger:** Inventory is tracked via immutable `StockMovement` rows. On-hand is strictly $\sum \Delta Q$.
- **Battery Shelf-Life FEFO:** Lithium-polymer power banks expire/require recharge after 180 days of storage.

## 3. LLM Agent Tools (Function Calling)
- `check_inventory_atp`: Check real-time Available-to-Promise stock across 8 warehouse locations.
- `calculate_smartgift_quote`: Calculate tier pricing (100, 300, 500, 1000 sets) with absorbed logistics and customization setup/run costs.
- `create_quote_stock_reservation`: Place a 7-day soft reservation on components for active B2B quotes.
- `dispatch_customization_order`: Issue raw stock to workshop for laser engraving or screen printing.
- `dispatch_kitting_order`: Explode BOM and assemble finished gift boxes.
- `inspect_battery_lots`: Audit lithium power banks approaching 180-day storage degradation limit.
